_format.note: Four creature archetypes — Striker, Warden, Weaver, Keeper. Each defines a shared stack mechanic (Momentum / Guard / Threads / Tend), a pool of abilities, and a tone. Species reference archetype via templates.json; their abilityPool draws from the archetype pool plus universal abilities. Hybrid breeding creates creatures with abilities from multiple archetypes — they track all relevant stacks simultaneously.

striker.name: Striker
striker.desc: Aggression. Builds Momentum by attacking; spends it for crushing payoffs.

warden.name: Warden
warden.desc: Endurance. Builds Guard from defensive plays; spends it as shielding and reflection.

weaver.name: Weaver
weaver.desc: Manipulation. Builds Threads by applying statuses; spends them to spread and amplify them.

keeper.name: Keeper
keeper.desc: Sustain. Builds Tend by healing; spends it for bigger heals, cleanses, or transferred protection.
